label: rem:q-hecke-operator-remark
title: Hecke relation for the $q$-Hecke operators
html:
The q-Hecke operators satisfy the Iwahori--Hecke algebra relation (braiding eigenvalues):

  (\mathbf{T}_{x,\lambda}^{(q)} - q)
  (\mathbf{T}_{x,\lambda}^{(q)} + q^{-1}) = 0.

They act with eigenvalues q and -q^{-1} on the symmetric and antisymmetric channels, respectively.
heading: Remark
